summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supply-chain data drop, then build an agent product that detects launch risks, drafts and takes supplier actions, and copes with new data drops.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses Sunday despite an 'all ok' plan (overbooked art books, failed statues, packing speed) and that new drops shifted risks. Built and pushed a poller/extractor/recheck/act platform with routines and a calm 'Today' UI on branch jonas/today-flow; verifier game-card gap fixed from 34,800 to 6,800. A voice two-step confirmation fix was in progress, and a restyle plus routine single-view work was still running.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhook or notification, so new drops must be detected by polling the file list and comparing SHA-256 checksums; files can be replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored data/ folder; .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and only .env.example is committed.
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md (claim work with a 'Now' line); Entire checkpoints are only written when repo files change and are pushed with git push.

Verifier shortfall counts inbound only when a supplier document confirms it; unread shipping documents are conservatively not counted. The recognizer put part numbers in the 'item' field rather than 'material_id', requiring a fallback when mapping doc lines.
Legacy routines written as code have no recipe and cannot render the When/Then/Always diagram; new routines are recipes, and the default mode is now 'ask' (existing routines keep theirs).
Sent emails cannot be undone, so the UI now shows an email review dialog before sending and omits Undo for sent mail; internal steps keep Undo.
Voice decisions now use a two-step prepare-then-decide flow with a one-time token, so tests call a conftest helper instead of decide directly.

code.finding: Parts now carry 'arriving' and 'not_counted' lists, and gap = needed - usable - arriving; arrivals count only if ETA is on or before launch, not cancelled, not already received, not overdue, and the supplier doc does not say less.
Wide view rewritten as When/Then/Always lanes that wrap; the narrow vertical view is kept for the panel and phone.
Holds all Today-screen wording built from card fields with nothing hardcoded.

workflow: Delegating parallel builders to separate file sets avoids edit conflicts; verify subagent output with screenshots and tests before committing.
Check for outside edits to a shared doc before updating it, and use mocked Playwright state so UI checks never send real supplier emails.
Ask before paid API calls and before pushing; a branch push was approved explicitly, so later pushes to it were announced as covered.
Do not put real data or the user's personal details in external services or shared docs; the portal login pasted in Discord should be rotated after the hack.

friction: Portal token was empty at the start, blocking all data work until it was supplied.
The dashboard showed 34,800 game cards short because the verifier ignored deliveries before packing end; no local shipping-advice reading existed until a paid OpenAI run was approved.
The UI offered Undo for already-sent emails, and phone Approve with no cost sends a real supplier email immediately.
Voice assistant said it would outline the plan but proceeded straight to done, skipping confirmation.
Legacy code-only routines failed and showed no diagram, and the routine UI had three redundant views (Flow, Steps, Expanded).
Teams header emoji replacement missed a multi-line match and needed a manual fix.
The early data check found five new drops within 37 minutes of the first download, and the sleep-deprived teammate Farhan was unavailable, so the verifier had to be fixed locally.

Wait for builders to finish automation inside Today and the restyle of Plan, Suppliers, evidence, login, PWA icon and Teams card, then check screenshots, run tests, commit and push.
Collapse the routine card into a single editable diagram view with 'Change it in your words' and a collapsed 'Show the code'.
Farhan's note: the allocate card's 'runs dry' time still ignores arrivals, and impact/__main__.py doesn't print the arriving list.
Send the Karton Nowak art-book order and the Boise reply once a sender address is registered in the portal Settings.

Delete data/state.json and other portal-data snapshots after the hack; decide whether to delete the earlier Claude doc, and rotate the leaked portal password.
Show the Standard 'runs out' risk as amber 'fixable by collecting' instead of red if the demo should look less drastic, and calm the Plan layout further.
